Notes into power

Count-in 4 beats → one note per beat → 3 rounds change the pattern and the tempo (80→100 BPM)

  1. ♩
    One note per beat

    The ring around the note drains to its beat and the clock counts down the flow. PERFECT ±90 ms · GREAT ±160 ms · GOOD ±240 ms

  2. ●
    Root notes are danger notes

    The red LED positions: miss one and Drake's ultimate costs −2 ♥

  3. ↕
    One scale, many rounds

    Up & down, thirds, down & up, scramble: each round re-orders the same position and may push the tempo +10 BPM. A round with no miss heals +1 ♥

TYPE IT LIKE YOU PLAY IT

Naturals are one key (c d e f g a b). Sharps add S or #: F# = fs. Backspace fixes a slip — the beat does not wait.

Late or wrong −1 ♥ · Root note −2 ♥ · Score 0–100,000

Make it yours

LED guide lights the whole position on the neck like the app's LED mode. Turn it off to play from memory (×1.25 XP, like the app). Note guide plays each note at its real pitch on its beat, so you hear the scale while you type it. Auto run types the scale for you so you can watch every effect; auto runs are not saved.
